patches.patches/wllama.patch: TypeScript: LoRA adapters from Blobs mounted as their own files; Wllama.capabilities.loraBlobs
patches.patches/llama.cpp-server-lora-cache.patc: server: a request without lora fields compares and clears like one with them; host prompt cache and idle-slot caching off while LoRA adapters are loaded
patches.patches/wllama-native-states-score.patch: TypeScript and glue: native_states load parameter (path or Blob, mounted as its own file), createNatlangScore (glue action score), Wllama.capabilities.nativeStates / natlangScore; a real deferred-task queue (a task that found no free slot was dropped)
patches.patches/llama.cpp-native-states-score.pa: llama.cpp ee85d96..9ff259a: native state spans (llama_state_span_register, --native-state, native_state content parts, also for CLI-submitted prompts) and POST /v1/natlang/score (shared server_score_tasks / server_score_response); an explicit continue_final_message false renders the final assistant message closed
